# ssync_provider (Resource)

The provider records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String)
- `sa_owner_id` (String)
- `type` (String) A provider type that has a spec the owner can see; GET /provider/available lists them

### Optional

- `config` (Attributes) The config the spec of the type declares. The keys the spec marks writeOnly are stored as the provider's samna secret and never returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `customer_id` (String) Merged into config
- `domain` (String) Merged into config
- `subject` (String) Merged into config
- `tenant_id` (String) Merged into config

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `app_id` (String, Sensitive)
- `app_slug` (String, Sensitive)
- `app_token` (String, Sensitive)
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `service_account_json` (String, Sensitive)
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive)
